209+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
210+;; The one dispatch point. Kind numbers (SEQ.md has the table):
211+;; 0 nil 1 int 2 EmptyList 3 List 4 Cons 5 LazySeq 6 ChunkedCons
212+;; 7 Range 8 InfiniteRange 9 Repeat 10 PVecSeq 11 PVec 12 ArrayChunk
213+;; 13 ChunkBuffer 14 Reduced 15 Bool 16 Fn 17 Str 18 foreign
214+;; 19 Char 20 Kw 21 Sym 22 Float 23 MapEntry 24 Atom 25 Volatile 26 Err
215+;; 27 ArrSeq (MapSeq/SetSeq)
216+(defn kind [x]
217+ (cond (wasm/null? x) 0
218+ (wasm/i31? x) 1
219+ (wasm/is? Int x) 1
220+ ;; the scalar boxes early: they are the common map keys (hash/equiv hot path)
221+ (wasm/is? Kw x) 20
222+ (wasm/is? Str x) 17
223+ (wasm/is? Float x) 22
224+ (wasm/is? Char x) 19
225+ (wasm/is? Sym x) 21
226+ (wasm/is? List x) (if (= 0 (wasm/get List 2 x)) 2 3)
227+ (wasm/is? Cons x) 4
228+ (wasm/is? LazySeq x) 5
229+ (wasm/is? ChunkedCons x) 6
230+ (wasm/is? Range x) 7
231+ (wasm/is? InfiniteRange x) 8
232+ (wasm/is? Repeat x) 9
233+ (wasm/is? PVecSeq x) 10
234+ (wasm/is? ArrSeq x) 27
235+ (wasm/is? pv/PVec x) 11
236+ (wasm/is? ArrayChunk x) 12
237+ (wasm/is? ChunkBuffer x) 13
238+ (wasm/is? Reduced x) 14
239+ (wasm/is? Bool x) 15
240+ (wasm/is? Fn x) 16
241+ (wasm/is? MapEntry x) 23
242+ (wasm/is? Atom x) 24
243+ (wasm/is? Volatile x) 25
244+ (wasm/is? Err x) 26
245+ :else 18))
246+
247+(defn kind-type-name
248+ "Type().Name() for seq.lg's kinds 0-27 (wasm.core/type-name delegates
249+ here); a foreign value (18) reads let-go.lang.Unknown."
250+ [x]
251+ (let [k (kind x)]
252+ (cond (= k 0) (wasm/bytes-of-string "nil")
253+ (= k 1) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.Int")
254+ (= k 22) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.Float")
255+ (= k 17) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.String")
256+ (= k 20) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.Keyword")
257+ (= k 21) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.Symbol")
258+ (= k 19) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.Character")
259+ (= k 15) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.Boolean")
260+ (= k 11) (if (= 0 (pv/vpkind x)) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.ArrayVector")
261+ (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.PersistentVector"))
262+ (= k 10) (if (= 0 (pv/vpkind (wasm/get PVecSeq 0 x))) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.PersistentList")
263+ (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.Sequence"))
264+ (= k 23) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.ArrayVector")
265+ (if (= k 7) true (= k 8)) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.Range")
266+ (= k 9) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.Repeat")
267+ (= k 14) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.Reduced")
268+ (= k 16) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.Fn")
269+ ;; List, Cons, LazySeq, ChunkedCons, PersistentVectorSeq, ArrayChunk,
270+ ;; ChunkBuffer, MapSeq/SetSeq: all ListType
271+ (if (if (>= k 2) (<= k 13) false) true (= k 27)) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.PersistentList")
272+ (= k 24) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.Atom")
273+ (= k 25) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.Volatile")
274+ (= k 26) (if (= 0 (wasm/get Err 0 x)) (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.ExceptionInfo")
275+ (wasm/bytes-of-string "java.lang.Exception"))
276+ :else (wasm/bytes-of-string "let-go.lang.Unknown"))))
277+
278+(defn seq-kind? [k] (if (if (>= k 2) (<= k 10) false) true (= k 27))) ; implements vm.Seq
279+(defn- seq-empty? [s] (let [k (kind s)] (if (= k 0) true (= k 2)))) ; SeqIsEmpty (iter.go:14)
280+(defn truthy? [x]
281+ (let [k (kind x)] (cond (= k 0) false (= k 15) (= 1 (wasm/get Bool 0 x)) :else true)))
282+
283+(defn empty-list [] (wasm/new List (wasm/null) (wasm/null) 0 (wasm/null)))
284+(defn arr-seq
285+ "A MapSeq (flavour 0) or SetSeq (1) over a pv/Node array, or null when the
286+ array is empty (Seq() of an empty map/set is EmptyList, seq'd to nil)."
287+ [arr flavour]
288+ (if (= 0 (wasm/alen arr)) (wasm/null) (wasm/new ArrSeq arr 0 flavour)))
289+(defn arr-seq-flavour "0 MapSeq, 1 SetSeq." [s] (wasm/get ArrSeq 2 s))
290+(defn- as-next [s] ; MapSeq/SetSeq.Next
291+ (let [a (wasm/get ArrSeq 0 s) i (inc (wasm/get ArrSeq 1 s))]
292+ (if (>= i (wasm/alen a)) (wasm/null) (wasm/new ArrSeq a i (wasm/get ArrSeq 2 s)))))
293+;; List.Cons (list.go:130) keeps the list's meta: (conj (with-meta '(1) m) 2) has m.
294+(defn- list-cons [l x] (wasm/new List x l (inc (wasm/get List 2 l)) (wasm/get List 3 l)))
295+(defn list-with-meta "A List cell like l with meta m (with-meta on a list)." [l m]
296+ (wasm/new List (wasm/get List 0 l) (wasm/get List 1 l) (wasm/get List 2 l) m))
297+(defn entry-vec "A MapEntry as the 2-vector it equals." [e]
298+ (pv/vconj (pv/vconj (pv/empty-vec) (wasm/get MapEntry 0 e)) (wasm/get MapEntry 1 e)))
299+
300+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
301+;; Strings as collections (moved from wasm.str at P2.9). A let-go String is a
302+;; Go string, so UTF-8 bytes: count/seq walk runes, nth is bounded by bytes
303+;; but found by runes (STR.md "Index semantics"). decode-at returns
304+;; rune*8 + size; an invalid or truncated sequence decodes as U+FFFD of size
305+;; 1, exactly as utf8.DecodeRune.
306+
307+(defn- cont? [c] (if (>= c 0x80) (<= c 0xBF) false))
308+
309+(defn decode-at [bs i n]
310+ (let [b0 (wasm/bget bs i)]
311+ (if (< b0 0x80)
312+ (+ (* b0 8) 1)
313+ (let [len (cond (< b0 0xC2) 0 (< b0 0xE0) 2 (< b0 0xF0) 3 (< b0 0xF5) 4 :else 0)
314+ lo (cond (= b0 0xE0) 0xA0 (= b0 0xF0) 0x90 :else 0x80)
315+ hi (cond (= b0 0xED) 0x9F (= b0 0xF4) 0x8F :else 0xBF)
316+ bad (+ (* 0xFFFD 8) 1)]
317+ (if (if (= len 0) true (> (+ i len) n))
318+ bad
319+ (let [b1 (wasm/bget bs (inc i))]
320+ (cond (if (< b1 lo) true (> b1 hi)) bad
321+ (= len 2) (+ (* (+ (* (bit-and b0 0x1F) 64) (bit-and b1 0x3F)) 8) 2)
322+ (= len 3) (let [b2 (wasm/bget bs (+ i 2))]
323+ (if (cont? b2)
324+ (+ (* (+ (* (bit-and b0 0x0F) 4096) (+ (* (bit-and b1 0x3F) 64) (bit-and b2 0x3F))) 8) 3)
325+ bad))
326+ :else (let [b2 (wasm/bget bs (+ i 2)) b3 (wasm/bget bs (+ i 3))]
327+ (if (if (cont? b2) (cont? b3) false)
328+ (+ (* (+ (+ (* (bit-and b0 0x07) 262144) (* (bit-and b1 0x3F) 4096))
329+ (+ (* (bit-and b2 0x3F) 64) (bit-and b3 0x3F))) 8) 4)
330+ bad)))))))))
331+
332+(defn rune-count* [bs]
333+ (let [n (wasm/alen bs)]
334+ (loop [i 0 c 0] (if (< i n) (recur (+ i (bit-and (decode-at bs i n) 7)) (inc c)) c))))
335+
336+(defn- string-seq [s] ; String.Seq() (string.go:259): a List of Chars, or null
337+ (let [bs (wasm/get Str 0 s) n (wasm/alen bs)]
338+ (if (= n 0)
339+ (wasm/null)
340+ (let [cnt (rune-count* bs) runes (wasm/array-new pv/Node cnt (wasm/null))]
341+ (loop [i 0 j 0]
342+ (when (< i n)
343+ (let [p (decode-at bs i n)]
344+ (wasm/aset! pv/Node runes j (wasm/new Char (unsigned-bit-shift-right p 3)))
345+ (recur (+ i (bit-and p 7)) (inc j)))))
346+ (loop [j (dec cnt) l (empty-list)]
347+ (if (< j 0) l (recur (dec j) (list-cons l (wasm/aget pv/Node runes j)))))))))
348+
349+(defn- string-nth [s i has-nf nf] ; Nth/Nth3 through String.ValueAt (string.go:276)
350+ (let [bs (wasm/get Str 0 s) n (wasm/alen bs)]
351+ (if (if (< i 0) true (>= i n))
352+ (if has-nf nf (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "nth index out of bounds")))
353+ ;; in range by bytes but past the last rune: ValueAt's default, nil, even for nth3
354+ (loop [b 0 r 0]
355+ (cond (>= b n) (wasm/null)
356+ (= r i) (wasm/new Char (unsigned-bit-shift-right (decode-at bs b n) 3))
357+ :else (recur (+ b (bit-and (decode-at bs b n) 7)) (inc r)))))))
358+
359+(defn bytes-eq? [a b]
360+ (let [n (wasm/alen a)]
361+ (if (= n (wasm/alen b))
362+ (loop [i 0] (if (< i n) (if (= (wasm/bget a i) (wasm/bget b i)) (recur (inc i)) false) true))
363+ false)))
364+
365+(defn- no-iseq-err [x] ; seqOf's/LazySeq's error (lang.go:1398, lazy_seq.go:127)
366+ (err-b (bytes-cat (wasm/bytes-of-string "don't know how to create ISeq from ") (type-name-bytes x))))
367+(defn- no-iseq [x] (throw (no-iseq-err x)))
368+
369+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
370+;; Range arithmetic wraps like Go's int (range.go), never throws like lg's +.
371+
372+(defn- range-count [r] ; Range.RawCount (range.go:97)
373+ (let [start (wasm/get Range 0 r) end (wasm/get Range 1 r) step (wasm/get Range 2 r)
374+ diff (wasm/i64-sub end start)]
375+ (cond (if (= step 1) true (= step -1)) (if (< diff 0) (wasm/i64-sub 0 diff) diff)
376+ (> step 0) (quot (wasm/i64-add diff (wasm/i64-sub step 1)) step)
377+ :else (quot (wasm/i64-add diff (wasm/i64-add step 1)) step))))
378+
379+(defn- in-bounds? [val end step] (if (> step 0) (< val end) (> val end)))
380+
381+(defn- new-range [s e st] ; vm.NewRange (range.go:188)
382+ (cond (= st 0) (empty-list)
383+ (if (> st 0) (> e s) false) (wasm/new Range s e st)
384+ (if (< st 0) (< e s) false) (wasm/new Range s e st)
385+ :else (empty-list)))
386+
387+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
388+;; LazySeq realisation (lazy_seq.go:47-150): the thunk runs once, its result
389+;; goes through Sequable.Seq() and an empty result is cached as null.
390+
391+(declare seq-view list can-seq?)
392+
393+;; A thunk that throws stores the error and clears fn: every later access
394+;; rethrows it and realized? is true (sval/seq, lazy_seq.go:47-150). The fn
395+;; slot is cleared only once the thunk has returned, so a throw can never
396+;; leave a null fn to call. Native drops sv BEFORE Sequable.Seq(): when that
397+;; throws (a nested lazy seq's thunk), nothing is stored and the next access
398+;; reads the outer seq as realized-empty, (). Mirrored: fn is cleared, done
399+;; stays 0, err stays null, so the next pass finds no thunk and caches ().
400+;; A non-seqable foreign value is the one Seq() failure native stores.
401+
402+(defn- lazy-fail [l e] (wasm/set! LazySeq 3 l e) (wasm/set! LazySeq 0 l (wasm/null)) (throw e))
403+
404+(defn- lazy-finish [l s0]
405+ (let [s (if (seq-empty? s0) (wasm/null) s0)]
406+ (wasm/set! LazySeq 1 l s)
407+ (wasm/set! LazySeq 2 l 1)
408+ s))
409+
410+(defn- lazy-step [l]
411+ (cond (= 1 (wasm/get LazySeq 2 l)) (wasm/get LazySeq 1 l)
412+ (if (wasm/null? (wasm/get LazySeq 3 l)) false true) (throw (wasm/get LazySeq 3 l))
413+ (wasm/null? (wasm/get LazySeq 0 l)) (lazy-finish l (wasm/null))
414+ :else
415+ (let [sv (try (invoke0 (wasm/get LazySeq 0 l)) (catch Throwable e (lazy-fail l e)))]
416+ (wasm/set! LazySeq 0 l (wasm/null))
417+ (lazy-finish l (cond (wasm/null? sv) (wasm/null)
418+ (= 18 (kind sv)) (try (seq-view sv) (catch Throwable e (lazy-fail l e)))
419+ (can-seq? sv) (seq-view sv)
420+ :else (lazy-fail l (no-iseq-err sv))))))) ; stored (lazy_seq.go:127)
421+
422+(defn- resolve-lazy [l] ; LazySeq.Resolve (lazy_seq.go:189)
423+ (loop [s (lazy-step l)]
424+ (if (= 5 (kind s)) (recur (lazy-step s)) s)))
425+
426+(defn- force-seq [s] (if (= 5 (kind s)) (resolve-lazy s) s)) ; forceSeq (lang.go:1426)
427+
428+(defn- vec-seq [v] ; PersistentVector.Seq (persistent_vector.go:262), ArrayVector.Seq
429+ (if (= 0 (pv/vcount v)) (empty-list) (wasm/new PVecSeq v 0 0)))
430+(defn- pvs-array? [s] (= 0 (pv/vpkind (wasm/get PVecSeq 0 s)))) ; an ArrayVectorSeq
431+(defn- pvs-clen [s] (let [c (wasm/get PVecSeq 2 s)] (if (< c 1) 1 c))) ; curChunkLen (vector.go:203)
432+
433+(defn- seq-view
434+ "Sequable.Seq() where the value has one, else the value as a Seq, else an
435+ error: what a LazySeq does with its thunk's result (lazy_seq.go:114-130)
436+ and what seqOf does with a non-lazy value (lang.go:1398)."
437+ [x]
438+ (let [k (kind x)]
439+ (cond (= k 5) (resolve-lazy x)
440+ (= k 7) (if (= 0 (range-count x)) (wasm/null) x)
441+ (seq-kind? k) x
442+ (= k 11) (vec-seq x)
443+ (= k 17) (string-seq x)
444+ (= k 18) (invoke1 (hook 1 x) x)
445+ (= k 23) (vec-seq (entry-vec x)) ; MapEntry.Seq: ArrayVector{k,v}.Seq(), an ArrayVectorSeq (FNV-hashed, P2.13)
446+ :else (no-iseq x))))
447+
448+(defn- can-seq? [x]
449+ (let [k (kind x)] (cond (= k 0) true (seq-kind? k) true (= k 11) true (= k 17) true (= k 18) true (= k 23) true :else false)))
450+
451+;; A foreign value native lg cannot seq: the caller raises its own catchable
452+;; message (bug-11). Only kind 18 is decided here; the other non-seqable kinds
453+;; keep their static traps (the D74 follow-up sweep).
454+(defn- opaque? [x]
455+ (if (= 18 (kind x))
456+ (let [p (wasm/get Hooks 4 hooks)] (if (wasm/null? p) false (if (truthy? (invoke1 p x)) false true)))
457+ false))
458+
459+(defn seq-of
460+ "rt.seqOf (lang.go:1398): nil for nil and empty, a LazySeq unresolved, any
461+ other seqable through seq-view with empty canonicalised to nil."
462+ [x]
463+ (let [k (kind x)]
464+ (cond (= k 0) (wasm/null)
465+ (= k 2) (wasm/null)
466+ (= k 5) x
467+ :else (let [s (seq-view x)] (if (seq-empty? s) (wasm/null) s)))))
468+
469+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
470+;; Chunks (chunk.go, range_chunked.go, persistent_vector_chunked.go)
471+
472+(defn- chunk-count* [c] (- (wasm/get ArrayChunk 2 c) (wasm/get ArrayChunk 1 c)))
473+(defn- chunk-nth* [c i] (wasm/aget pv/Node (wasm/get ArrayChunk 0 c) (+ (wasm/get ArrayChunk 1 c) i)))
474+(defn- chunk-drop-first [c]
475+ (wasm/new ArrayChunk (wasm/get ArrayChunk 0 c) (inc (wasm/get ArrayChunk 1 c)) (wasm/get ArrayChunk 2 c)))
476+(defn- cons-chunk [c more] ; ConsChunk (chunk.go:129)
477+ (if (= 0 (chunk-count* c)) more (wasm/new ChunkedCons c more)))
478+
479+(defn- range-chunk [start step n]
480+ (let [a (wasm/array-new pv/Node n (wasm/null))]
481+ (loop [i 0 v start]
482+ (when (< i n)
483+ (wasm/aset! pv/Node a i (box-int v))
484+ (recur (inc i) (wasm/i64-add v step))))
485+ (wasm/new ArrayChunk a 0 n)))
486+
487+(defn- tailoff [cnt] (if (< cnt 32) 0 (bit-shift-left (unsigned-bit-shift-right (dec cnt) 5) 5)))
488+
489+(defn- avseq-chunk [s] ; ArrayVectorSeq.ChunkedFirst (vector.go:258): [i, i+clen) clamped
490+ (let [v (wasm/get PVecSeq 0 s) i (wasm/get PVecSeq 1 s) cnt (pv/vcount v)
491+ e (if (> (+ i (pvs-clen s)) cnt) cnt (+ i (pvs-clen s))) a (wasm/array-new pv/Node (- e i) (wasm/null))]
492+ ;; Go windows the backing array; the trie is copied out (never mutated, so equivalent)
493+ (loop [j i] (when (< j e) (wasm/aset! pv/Node a (- j i) (pv/vnth v j)) (recur (inc j))))
494+ (wasm/new ArrayChunk a 0 (- e i))))
495+
496+(defn- pvseq-chunk [s] ; PersistentVectorSeq.chunkAt (persistent_vector_chunked.go:34)
497+ (let [v (wasm/get PVecSeq 0 s) i (wasm/get PVecSeq 1 s) to (tailoff (pv/vcount v))]
498+ (cond (pvs-array? s) (avseq-chunk s)
499+ (>= i to) (let [tail (wasm/get pv/PVec 3 v)] (wasm/new ArrayChunk tail (- i to) (wasm/alen tail)))
500+ ;; Go copies the leaf; pvec nodes are never mutated once built, so sharing is equivalent.
501+ :else
502+ (let [leaf (loop [node (wasm/get pv/PVec 2 v) level (wasm/get pv/PVec 1 v)]
503+ (if (> level 0)
504+ (recur (wasm/aget pv/Node node (bit-and (unsigned-bit-shift-right i level) 31)) (- level 5))
505+ node))]
506+ (wasm/new ArrayChunk leaf (- i (bit-and i -32)) (wasm/alen leaf))))))
507+
508+(defn- as-chunked [s] ; vm.AsChunkedSeq (chunked_seq.go:18); null if not chunked
509+ (loop [s s]
510+ (let [k (kind s)]
511+ (cond (= k 5) (recur (resolve-lazy s))
512+ (= k 6) s (= k 7) s (= k 8) s (= k 10) s
513+ :else (wasm/null)))))
514+
515+(defn- cfirst [s] ; ChunkedFirst; s from as-chunked
516+ (let [k (kind s)]
517+ (cond (= k 6) (wasm/get ChunkedCons 0 s)
518+ (= k 7) (let [n (range-count s)]
519+ (range-chunk (wasm/get Range 0 s) (wasm/get Range 2 s) (if (> n 32) 32 n)))
520+ (= k 8) (range-chunk (wasm/get InfiniteRange 0 s) (wasm/get InfiniteRange 1 s) 32)
521+ :else (pvseq-chunk s))))
522+
523+(defn- tail-next [more] ; the `more` step shared by Cons/ChunkedCons Next
524+ (let [k (kind more)]
525+ (cond (= k 0) (wasm/null) (= k 2) (wasm/null) (= k 5) (resolve-lazy more) :else more)))
526+
527+(defn- cnext [s] ; ChunkedNext
528+ (let [k (kind s)]
529+ (cond (= k 6) (tail-next (wasm/get ChunkedCons 1 s))
530+ (= k 7) (if (<= (range-count s) 32)
531+ (wasm/null)
532+ (wasm/new Range (wasm/i64-add (wasm/get Range 0 s) (wasm/i64-mul 32 (wasm/get Range 2 s)))
533+ (wasm/get Range 1 s) (wasm/get Range 2 s)))
534+ (= k 8) (wasm/new InfiniteRange (wasm/i64-add (wasm/get InfiniteRange 0 s) (wasm/i64-mul 32 (wasm/get InfiniteRange 1 s)))
535+ (wasm/get InfiniteRange 1 s))
536+ (pvs-array? s) (let [v (wasm/get PVecSeq 0 s) cl (pvs-clen s) ns (+ (wasm/get PVecSeq 1 s) cl)] ; ChunkedNext doubles clen
537+ (if (>= ns (pv/vcount v)) (wasm/null) (wasm/new PVecSeq v ns (* cl 2))))
538+ :else (let [v (wasm/get PVecSeq 0 s) i (wasm/get PVecSeq 1 s) cnt (pv/vcount v)]
539+ (if (>= i (tailoff cnt))
540+ (wasm/null)
541+ (let [ns (+ (bit-and i -32) 32)]
542+ (if (>= ns cnt) (wasm/null) (wasm/new PVecSeq v ns 0))))))))
543+
544+(defn- cmore [s] ; ChunkedMore
545+ (if (= 6 (kind s))
546+ (let [m (wasm/get ChunkedCons 1 s)] (if (wasm/null? m) (empty-list) m))
547+ (let [n (cnext s)] (if (wasm/null? n) (empty-list) n))))

549+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
550+;; Seq protocol per kind: s is a non-null seq kind (2..10).
551+
552+(defn- s-first [s]
553+ (let [k (kind s)]
554+ (cond (= k 2) (wasm/null)
555+ (= k 3) (wasm/get List 0 s)
556+ (= k 4) (wasm/get Cons 0 s)
557+ (= k 5) (let [r (resolve-lazy s)] (if (wasm/null? r) (wasm/null) (s-first r)))
558+ (= k 6) (chunk-nth* (wasm/get ChunkedCons 0 s) 0)
559+ (= k 7) (box-int (wasm/get Range 0 s))
560+ (= k 8) (box-int (wasm/get InfiniteRange 0 s))
561+ (= k 9) (if (= 0 (wasm/get Repeat 0 s)) (wasm/null) (wasm/get Repeat 1 s))
562+ (= k 27) (wasm/aget pv/Node (wasm/get ArrSeq 0 s) (wasm/get ArrSeq 1 s))
563+ :else (let [v (wasm/get PVecSeq 0 s) i (wasm/get PVecSeq 1 s)]
564+ (if (>= i (pv/vcount v)) (wasm/null) (pv/vnth v i))))))
565+
566+(defn- s-next [s]
567+ (let [k (kind s)]
568+ (cond (= k 2) (wasm/null)
569+ (= k 3) (if (<= (wasm/get List 2 s) 1) (wasm/null) (wasm/get List 1 s))
570+ (= k 4) (tail-next (wasm/get Cons 1 s))
571+ (= k 5) (let [r (resolve-lazy s)] (if (wasm/null? r) (wasm/null) (s-next r)))
572+ (= k 6) (let [c (wasm/get ChunkedCons 0 s)]
573+ (if (> (chunk-count* c) 1)
574+ (wasm/new ChunkedCons (chunk-drop-first c) (wasm/get ChunkedCons 1 s))
575+ (tail-next (wasm/get ChunkedCons 1 s))))
576+ (= k 7) (let [n (wasm/i64-add (wasm/get Range 0 s) (wasm/get Range 2 s))]
577+ (if (in-bounds? n (wasm/get Range 1 s) (wasm/get Range 2 s))
578+ (wasm/new Range n (wasm/get Range 1 s) (wasm/get Range 2 s))
579+ (wasm/null)))
580+ (= k 8) (wasm/new InfiniteRange (wasm/i64-add (wasm/get InfiniteRange 0 s) (wasm/get InfiniteRange 1 s))
581+ (wasm/get InfiniteRange 1 s))
582+ (= k 9) (let [i (wasm/get Repeat 0 s)]
583+ (if (if (= i 0) true (= i 1))
584+ (wasm/null)
585+ (wasm/new Repeat (if (> i 0) (dec i) i) (wasm/get Repeat 1 s))))
586+ (= k 27) (as-next s)
587+ :else (let [v (wasm/get PVecSeq 0 s) i (wasm/get PVecSeq 1 s)]
588+ (if (>= (inc i) (pv/vcount v)) (wasm/null) (wasm/new PVecSeq v (inc i) 0))))))
589+
590+(defn- s-more [s]
591+ (let [k (kind s)]
592+ (cond (= k 2) (empty-list)
593+ (= k 3) (if (<= (wasm/get List 2 s) 1) (empty-list) (wasm/get List 1 s))
594+ (= k 4) (let [m (wasm/get Cons 1 s)] (if (wasm/null? m) (empty-list) m))
595+ (= k 5) (let [r (resolve-lazy s)] (if (wasm/null? r) (empty-list) (s-more r)))
596+ (= k 6) (let [c (wasm/get ChunkedCons 0 s) m (wasm/get ChunkedCons 1 s)]
597+ (cond (> (chunk-count* c) 1) (wasm/new ChunkedCons (chunk-drop-first c) m)
598+ (wasm/null? m) (empty-list)
599+ :else m))
600+ :else (let [n (s-next s)] (if (wasm/null? n) (empty-list) n)))))
601+
602+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
603+;; Constructors and the seq natives
604+
605+(defn ^{:twin "core/list"} list
606+ ([] (empty-list))
607+ ([a] (list-cons (empty-list) a))
608+ ([a b] (list-cons (list b) a))
609+ ([a b c] (list-cons (list b c) a)))

611+(defn ^{:twin "core/lazy-seq*"} lazy-seq* [f] ; CoreLazySeq (lang.go:7885): any IFn, a non-Fn fails when realised
612+ (if (callable? f) (wasm/new LazySeq f (wasm/null) 0 (wasm/null)) (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "lazy-seq* expected a function"))))
613+
614+(defn ^{:twin "core/realized?"} realized? [x] ; CoreIsRealized (lang.go:8030); IsRealized (lazy_seq.go:38)
615+ (if (= 5 (kind x))
616+ (bool (if (= 1 (wasm/get LazySeq 2 x)) true (wasm/null? (wasm/get LazySeq 0 x))))

619+(defn ^{:twin "core/seq"} seq [x] ; seq (lang.go:2247)
620+ (cond (opaque? x) (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "seq expected Seqable"))
621+ (can-seq? x) (let [s (seq-of x)] (if (= 5 (kind s)) (resolve-lazy s) s))
622+ :else (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "seq expected Seqable"))))
623+
624+(defn ^{:twin "core/first"} first [x] ; first (lang.go:2166)
625+ (let [k (kind x)]
626+ (cond (= k 0) (wasm/null)
627+ (seq-kind? k) (s-first x)
628+ (opaque? x) (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "first expected Seq"))
629+ (can-seq? x) (let [s (seq-view x)] (if (seq-empty? s) (wasm/null) (s-first s)))
630+ :else (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "first expected Seq")))))
631+
632+(defn ^{:twin "core/next"} next [x] ; next (lang.go:2193)
633+ (cond (opaque? x) (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "next expected Seq"))
634+ (can-seq? x) (let [s (seq-of x)] (if (wasm/null? s) (wasm/null) (s-next s)))
635+ :else (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "next expected Seq"))))
636+
637+(defn ^{:twin "core/rest"} rest [x] ; rest (lang.go:2222)
638+ (cond (opaque? x) (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "rest expected Seq"))
639+ (can-seq? x) (let [s (seq-of x)] (if (wasm/null? s) (empty-list) (s-more s)))
640+ :else (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "rest expected Seq"))))
641+
642+(defn ^{:twin "core/cons"} cons [x coll] ; builtins.Cons (builtins.go:56)
643+ (cond (opaque? coll) (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "cons expected Seq"))
644+ (can-seq? coll) (wasm/new Cons x (seq-of coll))
645+ :else (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "cons expected Seq"))))
646+
647+(defn ^{:twin "core/second"} second [x] ; CoreSecond (lang.go:6011)
648+ (cond (opaque? x) (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "second expected Seq"))

650+ (if (wasm/null? s) (wasm/null) (let [n (s-next s)] (if (wasm/null? n) (wasm/null) (s-first n)))))
651+ :else (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "second expected Seq"))))

653+(defn last [s] ; lg-defined (core.lg:1480), here for completeness
654+ (loop [s s]
655+ (let [n (next s)] (if (wasm/null? n) (first s) (recur n)))))

657+(defn- cons-tail-count [tail] ; consTailCount (cons.go:76)
658+ (loop [n 0 s tail]
659+ (cond (= 5 (kind s)) (recur n (lazy-step s))
660+ (seq-empty? s) n
661+ :else (recur (inc n) (s-next s)))))

663+(defn- count* [x] ; CoreCount (lang.go:6097) over each kind's Count
664+ (let [k (kind x)]
665+ (cond (= k 0) 0
666+ (= k 2) 0
667+ (= k 3) (wasm/get List 2 x)
668+ (= k 4) (inc (cons-tail-count (wasm/get Cons 1 x)))
669+ (= k 5) (loop [n 0 s (lazy-step x)] (if (seq-empty? s) n (recur (inc n) (s-next s))))
670+ (= k 7) (range-count x)
671+ (= k 9) (wasm/get Repeat 0 x) ; -1 for (repeat x): repeat.go:68
672+ (= k 10) (- (pv/vcount (wasm/get PVecSeq 0 x)) (wasm/get PVecSeq 1 x))
673+ (= k 27) (- (wasm/alen (wasm/get ArrSeq 0 x)) (wasm/get ArrSeq 1 x))
674+ (= k 11) (pv/vcount x)
675+ (= k 12) (chunk-count* x)
676+ (= k 13) (wasm/get ChunkBuffer 1 x)
677+ (= k 17) (rune-count* (wasm/get Str 0 x)) ; runes, not bytes (lang.go:6105)
678+ (= k 18) (unbox-int (invoke1 (hook 2 x) x))

680+ :else (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "count expected Counted"))))) ; incl. ChunkedCons, InfiniteRange

682+(defn ^{:twin "core/count"} count [x] (box-int (count* x)))

684+(defn- nth-in-seq [s n] ; nthInSeq (lang.go:1453); null s = not found
685+ (loop [i 0 s s]
686+ (if (wasm/null? s)
687+ (wasm/null)
688+ (let [cs (as-chunked s)]
689+ (if (wasm/null? cs)
690+ (if (= i n) (wasm/new Cons (s-first s) (wasm/null)) (recur (inc i) (s-next s)))
691+ (let [c (cfirst cs) nc (chunk-count* c)]
692+ (if (< n (+ i nc))
693+ (wasm/new Cons (chunk-nth* c (- n i)) (wasm/null))
694+ (recur (+ i nc) (cnext cs)))))))))

696+(defn- indexed-nth [x k i]
697+ (cond (= k 7) (box-int (wasm/i64-add (wasm/get Range 0 x) (wasm/i64-mul i (wasm/get Range 2 x))))
698+ (= k 10) (pv/vnth (wasm/get PVecSeq 0 x) (+ (wasm/get PVecSeq 1 x) i))
699+ (= k 11) (pv/vnth x i)
700+ :else (chunk-nth* x i)))

702+(defn- oob [has-nf nf] (if has-nf nf (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "nth index out of bounds"))))

704+(defn- nth* [coll i has-nf nf] ; Nth/Nth3 (native_prims.go:155-215)
705+ (let [k (kind coll)]
706+ (cond (= k 0) nf
707+ (= k 17) (string-nth coll i has-nf nf) ; Indexed with byte RawCount, rune ValueAt
708+ ;; vm.Indexed: Range, PersistentVectorSeq, PersistentVector, ArrayChunk
709+ (if (= k 7) true (if (= k 10) true (if (= k 11) true (= k 12))))
710+ (if (if (< i 0) true (>= i (count* coll))) (oob has-nf nf) (indexed-nth coll k i))
711+ (< i 0) (oob has-nf nf)
712+ (if has-nf (if (can-seq? coll) (opaque? coll) true) false) nf
713+ :else (let [hit (nth-in-seq (force-seq (seq-of coll)) i)]
714+ (if (wasm/null? hit) (oob has-nf nf) (wasm/get Cons 0 hit))))))

716+(defn nth ; the core/nth twin is wasm.core/nth (adds TransientVector)
717+ ([coll i] (nth* coll (unbox-int i) false (wasm/null)))
718+ ([coll i nf] (nth* coll (unbox-int i) true nf)))

720+(defn peek [x] ; CorePeek (lang.go:6707)
721+ (let [k (kind x)]
722+ (cond (= k 0) (wasm/null)
723+ (= k 11) (if (= 0 (pv/vcount x)) (wasm/null) (pv/vnth x (dec (pv/vcount x))))
724+ (= k 2) (wasm/null)
725+ (= k 3) (wasm/get List 0 x)
726+ :else (raise-typed (wasm/bytes-of-string "peek not supported on ") x))))

728+(defn pop [x] ; CorePop (lang.go:6739)
729+ (let [k (kind x)]
730+ (cond (= k 0) (wasm/null)
731+ (= k 11) (if (< (pv/vcount x) 1) (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "can't pop empty vector")) (pv/vpop x))
732+ (= k 2) (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "can't pop empty seq"))
733+ (= k 23) (list (wasm/get MapEntry 1 x)) ; MapEntry.More
734+ (seq-kind? k)
735+ ;; the Counted test walks a Cons/LazySeq to its end, as Go's does

737+ (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "can't pop empty seq"))

739+ :else (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "pop expected Seq or Vec")))))

741+(defn- conj1 [coll x] ; one step of Conj (native_prims.go:293)

743+ (cond (= k 0) (list-cons (empty-list) x)
744+ (= k 2) (list-cons coll x)
745+ (= k 3) (list-cons coll x)
746+ (= k 10) (loop [i (dec (pv/vcount (wasm/get PVecSeq 0 coll))) l (empty-list)] ; PersistentVectorSeq.Conj copies to a List
747+ (if (< i (wasm/get PVecSeq 1 coll))
748+ (list-cons l x)
749+ (recur (dec i) (list-cons l (pv/vnth (wasm/get PVecSeq 0 coll) i)))))
750+ (= k 11) (pv/vconj coll x)
751+ (= k 23) (pv/vconj (entry-vec coll) x) ; MapEntry.Conj: as the ArrayVector

753+ ;; reports the recovered panic as a catchable error (map.go:159)
754+ (= k 27) (raise-b (wasm/bytes-of-string "interface conversion: vm.Seq is *vm.Cons, not *vm.List"))

291+ n2 (loop [r r0 w 0 n (times-ten-pow n1 ext)]
292+ (if (< r nd)
293+ (let [c (wasm/bget d r) dig (unsigned-bit-shift-right n k) n (bit-and n mask)]
294+ (wasm/bset! d w dig)
295+ (recur (inc r) (inc w) (+ (* n 10) c)))
296+ n))
297+ ;; put down extra digits
298+ w (loop [w w0 n n2]
299+ (if (> n 0)
300+ (let [dig (unsigned-bit-shift-right n k) n (bit-and n mask)]
301+ (if (< w 800)
302+ (do (wasm/bset! d w dig) (recur (inc w) (* n 10)))
303+ (do (when (> dig 0) (wasm/set! Dec 3 a 1)) (recur w (* n 10)))))
304+ w))]
305+ (wasm/set! Dec 2 a (- (d-dp a) (dec r0)))
306+ (wasm/set! Dec 1 a w)
307+ (dec-trim! a)))))
308+
309+(defn- left-shift! [a k] ; leftShift, k <= 59
310+ (let [d (wasm/get Dec 0 a) nd (d-nd a) tmp (wasm/bytes-new (+ nd 20))
311+ w0 (loop [r (dec nd) w 0 n 0] ; digits, least significant first, into tmp
312+ (if (>= r 0)
313+ (let [n (+ n (bit-shift-left (wasm/bget d r) k)) q (quot n 10)]
314+ (wasm/bset! tmp w (- n (* 10 q)))
315+ (recur (dec r) (inc w) q))
316+ (loop [w w n n]
317+ (if (> n 0)
318+ (let [q (quot n 10)] (wasm/bset! tmp w (- n (* 10 q))) (recur (inc w) q))
319+ w))))
320+ keep (if (> w0 800) 800 w0)]
321+ (loop [i 0] (when (< i keep) (wasm/bset! d i (wasm/bget tmp (- w0 (inc i)))) (recur (inc i))))
322+ (loop [i keep] (when (< i w0) (when (> (wasm/bget tmp (- w0 (inc i))) 0) (wasm/set! Dec 3 a 1)) (recur (inc i))))
323+ (wasm/set! Dec 1 a keep)
324+ (wasm/set! Dec 2 a (+ (d-dp a) (- w0 nd)))
325+ (dec-trim! a)))
326+
327+(defn- dec-shift! [a k] ; Shift: binary left (k > 0) or right (k < 0)
328+ (cond (= 0 (d-nd a)) nil
329+ (> k 0) (loop [k k] (if (> k 59) (do (left-shift! a 59) (recur (- k 59))) (left-shift! a k)))
330+ (< k 0) (loop [k k] (if (< k -59) (do (right-shift! a 59) (recur (+ k 59))) (right-shift! a (- 0 k))))
331+ :else nil))
332+
333+(defn- should-round-up? [a nd]
334+ (cond (if (< nd 0) true (>= nd (d-nd a))) false
335+ (if (= 5 (d-at a nd)) (= (inc nd) (d-nd a)) false) ; exactly halfway: round to even
336+ (if (= 1 (wasm/get Dec 3 a)) true (if (> nd 0) (= 1 (bit-and (d-at a (dec nd)) 1)) false))
337+ :else (>= (d-at a nd) 5)))
338+
339+(defn- round-down! [a nd]
340+ (when (if (< nd 0) false (< nd (d-nd a)))
341+ (wasm/set! Dec 1 a nd)
342+ (dec-trim! a)))
343+
344+(defn- round-up! [a nd]
345+ (when (if (< nd 0) false (< nd (d-nd a)))
346+ (let [d (wasm/get Dec 0 a)]
347+ (loop [i (dec nd)]
348+ (if (>= i 0)
349+ (if (< (wasm/bget d i) 9)
350+ (do (wasm/bset! d i (inc (wasm/bget d i))) (wasm/set! Dec 1 a (inc i)))
351+ (recur (dec i)))
352+ (do (wasm/bset! d 0 1) (wasm/set! Dec 1 a 1) (wasm/set! Dec 2 a (inc (d-dp a)))))))))
353+
354+(defn- dec-round! [a nd]
355+ (when (if (< nd 0) false (< nd (d-nd a)))
356+ (if (should-round-up? a nd) (round-up! a nd) (round-down! a nd))))
357+
358+(defn- round-shortest!
359+ "roundShortest (Go 1.26 internal/strconv/ftoa.go:262): round d, the exact
360+ decimal of mant * 2^(exp-52), to the fewest digits that still parse back
361+ to the same double. mant carries the implicit bit; exp is unbiased."
362+ [d mant exp]
363+ (cond
364+ (= mant 0) (wasm/set! Dec 1 d 0)
365+ ;; already shortest: fewer digits than the binary point allows
366+ (if (> exp -1022) (>= (* 332 (- (d-dp d) (d-nd d))) (* 100 (- exp 52))) false) nil
367+ :else
368+ (let [upper (dec-new)
369+ lo1 (if (> mant 4503599627370496) true (= exp -1022))
370+ mantlo (if lo1 (dec mant) (dec (* 2 mant)))
371+ explo (if lo1 exp (dec exp))
372+ lower (dec-new)
373+ inclusive (= 0 (bit-and mant 1))]
374+ (dec-assign! upper (inc (* 2 mant)))
375+ (dec-shift! upper (- exp 53))
376+ (dec-assign! lower (inc (* 2 mantlo)))
377+ (dec-shift! lower (- explo 53))
378+ (loop [ui 0 upperdelta 0]
379+ (let [mi (+ (- ui (d-dp upper)) (d-dp d))]
380+ (when (< mi (d-nd d))
381+ (let [li (+ (- ui (d-dp upper)) (d-dp lower))
382+ l (if (if (>= li 0) (< li (d-nd lower)) false) (d-at lower li) 0)
383+ m (if (>= mi 0) (d-at d mi) 0)
384+ u (if (< ui (d-nd upper)) (d-at upper ui) 0)
385+ okdown (if (= l m) (if inclusive (= (inc li) (d-nd lower)) false) true)
386+ ud (cond (if (= upperdelta 0) (< (inc m) u) false) 2
387+ (if (= upperdelta 0) (if (= m u) false true) false) 1
388+ (if (= upperdelta 1) (if (= m 9) (if (= u 0) false true) true) false) 2
389+ :else upperdelta)
390+ okup (if (> ud 0) (if inclusive true (if (> ud 1) true (< (inc ui) (d-nd upper)))) false)]
391+ (cond (if okdown okup false) (dec-round! d (inc mi))
392+ okdown (round-down! d (inc mi))
393+ okup (round-up! d (inc mi))
394+ :else (recur (inc ui) ud)))))))))

396+;; fmtEFG's %f and %e arms (Go internal/strconv/ftoa.go), digits from a Dec.
397+
398+(defn- write-f [b d prec]
399+ (let [nd (d-nd d) dp (d-dp d)]
400+ (if (> dp 0)
401+ (let [m (if (< nd dp) nd dp)]
402+ (loop [i 0] (when (< i m) (buf-byte! b (+ 48 (d-at d i))) (recur (inc i))))
403+ (loop [i m] (when (< i dp) (buf-byte! b 48) (recur (inc i)))))
404+ (buf-byte! b 48))
405+ (when (> prec 0)
406+ (buf-byte! b 46)
407+ (let [ndp (if (< dp 0) (- 0 dp) 0)
408+ lz (if (< prec ndp) prec ndp)
409+ off (+ dp lz)
410+ avail (if (> (- nd off) 0) (- nd off) 0)
411+ m (if (< (- prec lz) avail) (- prec lz) avail)]
412+ (loop [i 0] (when (< i lz) (buf-byte! b 48) (recur (inc i))))
413+ (loop [i 0] (when (< i m) (buf-byte! b (+ 48 (d-at d (+ off i)))) (recur (inc i))))
414+ (loop [i (+ lz m)] (when (< i prec) (buf-byte! b 48) (recur (inc i))))))))
415+
416+(defn- write-e [b d prec]
417+ (let [nd (d-nd d)]
418+ (buf-byte! b (if (= nd 0) 48 (+ 48 (d-at d 0))))
419+ (when (> prec 0)
420+ (buf-byte! b 46)
421+ (let [m (if (< nd (inc prec)) nd (inc prec))]
422+ (loop [i 1] (when (< i m) (buf-byte! b (+ 48 (d-at d i))) (recur (inc i))))
423+ (loop [i (if (< m 1) 1 m)] (when (< i (inc prec)) (buf-byte! b 48) (recur (inc i))))))
424+ (buf-byte! b 101)
425+ (let [x (if (= nd 0) 0 (dec (d-dp d)))
426+ ax (if (< x 0) (- 0 x) x)]
427+ (buf-byte! b (if (< x 0) 45 43))
428+ (cond (< ax 10) (do (buf-byte! b 48) (buf-byte! b (+ 48 ax)))
429+ (< ax 100) (do (buf-byte! b (+ 48 (quot ax 10))) (buf-byte! b (+ 48 (- ax (* 10 (quot ax 10))))))
430+ :else (do (buf-byte! b (+ 48 (quot ax 100)))
431+ (buf-byte! b (+ 48 (- (quot ax 10) (* 10 (quot ax 100)))))
432+ (buf-byte! b (+ 48 (- ax (* 10 (quot ax 10))))))))))
433+
434+(defn- write-float-bits!
435+ "Float.String() (float.go:60): integral finite values as
436+ FormatFloat(f, 'f', 1, 64), everything else FormatFloat(f, 'g', -1, 64)."
437+ [b bits]
438+ (let [neg (< bits 0)
439+ ex (bit-and (wasm/i64-shr-u bits 52) 0x7ff)
440+ fr (bit-and bits 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFF)]
441+ (if (= ex 0x7ff)
442+ (cond (> fr 0) (buf-bytes! b (wasm/bytes-of-string "NaN"))
443+ neg (buf-bytes! b (wasm/bytes-of-string "-Inf"))
444+ :else (buf-bytes! b (wasm/bytes-of-string "+Inf")))
445+ (let [mant (if (= ex 0) fr (bit-or fr 4503599627370496))
446+ exp (- (if (= ex 0) 1 ex) 1023)
447+ e2 (- exp 52) ; value = mant * 2^e2
448+ integral (cond (= mant 0) true
449+ (>= e2 0) true
450+ (< e2 -52) false
451+ :else (= 0 (bit-and mant (dec (bit-shift-left 1 (- 0 e2))))))
452+ d (dec-new)]
453+ (when neg (buf-byte! b 45))
454+ (dec-assign! d mant)
455+ (dec-shift! d e2)
456+ (if integral
457+ (write-f b d 1)
458+ (do (round-shortest! d mant exp)
459+ (let [nd (d-nd d) dp (d-dp d) x (dec dp)]
460+ ;; shortest %g: eprec is 6, %e precision nd-1, %f precision max(nd-dp, 0)
461+ (if (if (< x -4) true (>= x 6))
462+ (write-e b d (dec nd))
463+ (write-f b d (if (> nd dp) (- nd dp) 0))))))))))
464+
465+(defn float->str [x]
466+ (let [b (buf-new)] (write-float-bits! b (sq/float-bits (unbox-float x))) (buf-done b)))

468+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
469+;; Printing. write-val is Value.String() for nested values (readably) and
470+;; the print-method path of print-str (not readably: strings and chars raw
471+;; at every depth, print_method.go:30). The top level of str is strValue
472+;; (lang.go:5006): nil is "", strings and chars raw, +-Inf as Infinity.
473+
474+(defn set-print-hook!
475+ "Install the printer for foreign values (maps, sets): a closure called as
476+ (f x mode) returning a Str, mode a boxed Int as write-val's (0 String(),
477+ 1 pr-str, 2 print-str)."
478+ [f] (wasm/set! Globals 2 globals f))

480+(defn- write-quoted [b s] ; String.String() (string.go:309)
481+ (let [bs (str-bytes s) n (wasm/alen bs)]
482+ (buf-byte! b 34)
483+ (loop [i 0]
484+ (when (< i n)
485+ (let [p (sq/decode-at bs i n) r (unsigned-bit-shift-right p 3) sz (bit-and p 7)]
486+ (cond (= r 34) (do (buf-byte! b 92) (buf-byte! b 34))
487+ (= r 92) (do (buf-byte! b 92) (buf-byte! b 92))
488+ (= r 9) (do (buf-byte! b 92) (buf-byte! b 116))
489+ (= r 13) (do (buf-byte! b 92) (buf-byte! b 114))
490+ (= r 10) (do (buf-byte! b 92) (buf-byte! b 110))
491+ (= r 8) (do (buf-byte! b 92) (buf-byte! b 98))
492+ (= r 12) (do (buf-byte! b 92) (buf-byte! b 102))
493+ (if (< r 0x20) true (= r 0x7f))
494+ (do (buf-byte! b 92) (buf-byte! b 117) (buf-byte! b 48) (buf-byte! b 48)
495+ (buf-byte! b (hex-digit (unsigned-bit-shift-right r 4))) (buf-byte! b (hex-digit (bit-and r 15))))
496+ (= r 0xFFFD) (encode-rune! b r) ; an invalid byte is written as U+FFFD (WriteRune)
497+ :else (buf-range! b bs i (+ i sz)))
498+ (recur (+ i sz)))))
499+ (buf-byte! b 34)))
500+
501+(defn- write-char-name [b r] ; Char.String() (char.go:50)
502+ (buf-byte! b 92)
503+ (cond (= r 32) (buf-bytes! b (wasm/bytes-of-string "space"))
504+ (= r 10) (buf-bytes! b (wasm/bytes-of-string "newline"))
505+ (= r 9) (buf-bytes! b (wasm/bytes-of-string "tab"))
506+ (= r 13) (buf-bytes! b (wasm/bytes-of-string "return"))
507+ :else (encode-rune! b r)))
508+
509+(defn- write-named [b x]
510+ (let [ns (named-ns x)]
511+ (when-not (wasm/null? ns) (buf-bytes! b ns) (buf-byte! b 47))
512+ (buf-bytes! b (named-name x))))
513+
514+(declare write-val)
515+
516+(defn- write-seq [b x mode]
517+ (buf-byte! b 40)
518+ (loop [s (sq/seq x) first? true]
519+ (when-not (wasm/null? s)
520+ (when-not first? (buf-byte! b 32))
521+ (write-val b (sq/first s) mode)
522+ (recur (sq/next s) false)))
523+ (buf-byte! b 41))
524+
525+(defn- write-pvec [b v mode]
526+ (buf-byte! b 91)
527+ (loop [i 0]
528+ (when (< i (pv/vcount v))
529+ (when (> i 0) (buf-byte! b 32))
530+ (write-val b (pv/vnth v i) mode)
531+ (recur (inc i))))
532+ (buf-byte! b 93))
533+
534+;; mode: 0 Value.String() (str's nested values), 1 pr-str, 2 print-str (not
535+;; readably). 0 and 1 differ only in the foreign printer: a map's String()
536+;; separates entries with " ", its print-method with ", " (print_method.go).
537+(defn- write-val [b x mode]
538+ (let [k (sq/kind x) readably (if (= mode 2) false true)]
539+ (cond (= k 0) (buf-bytes! b (wasm/bytes-of-string "nil"))
540+ (= k 1) (buf-int! b (sq/unbox-int x))
541+ (= k 15) (buf-bytes! b (if (= 1 (wasm/get sq/Bool 0 x)) (wasm/bytes-of-string "true") (wasm/bytes-of-string "false")))
542+ (= k 17) (if readably (write-quoted b x) (buf-bytes! b (str-bytes x)))
543+ (= k 19) (if readably (write-char-name b (char-val x)) (encode-rune! b (char-val x)))
544+ (= k 20) (do (buf-byte! b 58) (write-named b x))
545+ (= k 21) (write-named b x)
546+ (= k 22) (write-float-bits! b (sq/float-bits (unbox-float x)))
547+ ;; A PersistentVector, its seq and a Repeat print their elements through
548+ ;; Value.String() in every mode (no print-method of their own); the seq
549+ ;; of a PersistentVector prints the whole vector (persistent_vector.go:748)
550+ (if (= k 10) (= 1 (pv/vpkind (wasm/get sq/PVecSeq 0 x))) false)
551+ (do (buf-bytes! b (wasm/bytes-of-string "(seq ")) (write-pvec b (wasm/get sq/PVecSeq 0 x) 0) (buf-byte! b 41))
552+ (= k 9) (write-seq b x 0)
553+ (sq/seq-kind? k) (write-seq b x mode) ; incl. MapSeq/SetSeq (27)
554+ (= k 11) (write-pvec b x (if (= 1 (pv/vpkind x)) 0 mode))
555+ (= k 23) (write-pvec b (sq/entry-vec x) mode) ; MapEntry.String(): [k v]
556+ ;; Reduced prints "#reduced<v>" with v's String() in every mode; an ArrayChunk's
557+ ;; String() is "[e ...]" and a ChunkBuffer's "#<chunk-buffer>", but neither has a
558+ ;; print-method: pr-str/print-str seq them and fail natively (P2.13)
559+ (= k 14) (do (buf-bytes! b (wasm/bytes-of-string "#reduced<")) (write-val b (sq/unreduced x) 0) (buf-byte! b 62))
560+ (if (= k 12) true (= k 13))
561+ (cond (if (= mode 0) false true) (raise-lit (wasm/bytes-of-string "seq expected Seqable"))
562+ (= k 13) (buf-bytes! b (wasm/bytes-of-string "#<chunk-buffer>"))
563+ :else (let [n (sq/unbox-int (sq/count x))]
564+ (buf-byte! b 91)
565+ (loop [i 0] (when (< i n) (when (> i 0) (buf-byte! b 32)) (write-val b (sq/nth x (sq/box-int i)) 0) (recur (inc i))))
566+ (buf-byte! b 93)))
567+ ;; foreign kinds and the P2.7 boxes (atom, volatile, exception) print through wasm.core
568+ (if (= k 18) true (>= k 24)) (let [h (wasm/get Globals 2 globals)]
569+ (if (wasm/null? h)
570+ (wasm/trap "wasm.str: printing a foreign value and no print hook installed")
571+ (buf-bytes! b (str-bytes (sq/invoke2 h x (sq/box-int mode))))))
572+ :else (wasm/trap "wasm.str: printing this kind is not implemented"))))
573+
574+(defn- write-str-val [b x] ; strValue (lang.go:5006)
575+ (let [k (sq/kind x)]
576+ (cond (= k 0) nil
577+ (= k 17) (buf-bytes! b (str-bytes x))
578+ (= k 19) (encode-rune! b (char-val x))
579+ (= k 22) (let [f (unbox-float x)]
580+ (cond (> f 1.7976931348623157e308) (buf-bytes! b (wasm/bytes-of-string "Infinity"))
581+ (< f -1.7976931348623157e308) (buf-bytes! b (wasm/bytes-of-string "-Infinity"))
582+ :else (write-float-bits! b (sq/float-bits f))))
583+ :else (write-val b x 0))))

585+;; mode 0 = str, 1 = pr-str, 2 = print-str (prThroughToString: space-separated)
586+(defn- write-arg [b x mode first?]
587+ (cond (= mode 0) (write-str-val b x)
588+ :else (do (when-not first? (buf-byte! b 32)) (write-val b x mode))))

590+(defn- out1 [mode a] (let [b (buf-new)] (write-arg b a mode true) (buf-done b)))
591+(defn- out2 [mode a c] (let [b (buf-new)] (write-arg b a mode true) (write-arg b c mode false) (buf-done b)))
592+(defn- out3 [mode a c d]
593+ (let [b (buf-new)] (write-arg b a mode true) (write-arg b c mode false) (write-arg b d mode false) (buf-done b)))
594+(defn- out-seq [mode xs]
595+ (let [b (buf-new)]
596+ (loop [s (sq/seq xs) first? true]
597+ (when-not (wasm/null? s) (write-arg b (sq/first s) mode first?) (recur (sq/next s) false)))
598+ (buf-done b)))

601+;; the -seq forms take the argument list (what apply passes).
602+(defn ^{:twin "core/str"} str ([] (lit "")) ([a] (out1 0 a)) ([a b] (out2 0 a b)) ([a b c] (out3 0 a b c)))
603+(defn ^{:twin "core/pr-str"} pr-str ([] (lit "")) ([a] (out1 1 a)) ([a b] (out2 1 a b)) ([a b c] (out3 1 a b c)))
604+(defn ^{:twin "core/print-str"} print-str ([] (lit "")) ([a] (out1 2 a)) ([a b] (out2 2 a b)) ([a b c] (out3 2 a b c)))
605+(defn str-seq [xs] (out-seq 0 xs))

612+;; A string as a collection. Go's String is Indexed with RawCount = BYTE

614+;; The walks live in wasm.seq (decode-at, rune-count*, string-seq, string-nth).

616+;; wasm.seq's natives are string-aware since P2.9; these names stay so
617+;; callers written against wasm.str keep resolving.
618+(defn count [x] (sq/count x))
619+(defn nth ([coll i] (sq/nth coll i)) ([coll i nf] (sq/nth coll i nf)))
620+(defn seq [x] (sq/seq x))
621+(defn first [x] (sq/first x))
622+(defn rest [x] (sq/rest x))
623+(defn next [x] (sq/next x))

626+;; Equality and hash of every box are wasm.seq's (corpus/hash/SPEC.md,

629+(defn equiv? [a b] (sq/equiv? a b))
630+(defn equals [a b] (sq/equals a b))
631+(defn hash* [x] (sq/unbox-int (sq/hash x)))
632+(defn hash [x] (sq/box-int (hash* x)))

639+(defn- num-cmp [a ka b kb] ; NumLt / NumGt; NaN compares 0
640+ (if (if (= ka 1) (= kb 1) false)
641+ (let [x (sq/unbox-int a) y (sq/unbox-int b)] (cond (< x y) -1 (> x y) 1 :else 0))
642+ (let [x (if (= ka 1) (wasm/i64-to-f64 (sq/unbox-int a)) (unbox-float a))
643+ y (if (= kb 1) (wasm/i64-to-f64 (sq/unbox-int b)) (unbox-float b))]
644+ (cond (< x y) -1 (> x y) 1 :else 0))))
645+
646+(defn- part-cmp [x y] ; compareNamePart: null reads as ""
647+ (bytes-cmp (if (wasm/null? x) (wasm/bytes-new 0) x) (if (wasm/null? y) (wasm/bytes-new 0) y)))
648+
649+(defn- pvec-cmp [a b] ; lexicographic over the seqs
650+ (let [na (pv/vcount a) nb (pv/vcount b)]
651+ (loop [i 0]
652+ (cond (if (< i na) (< i nb) false)
653+ (let [c (compare* (pv/vnth a i) (pv/vnth b i))] (if (= c 0) (recur (inc i)) c))
654+ (if (>= i na) (>= i nb) false) 0
655+ (>= i na) -1
656+ :else 1))))
657+
658+(defn- num-kind? [k] (if (= k 1) true (= k 22)))
659+
660+(defn compare* [a b]
661+ (let [a (if (= 23 (sq/kind a)) (sq/entry-vec a) a) ; a MapEntry compares as its 2-vector
662+ b (if (= 23 (sq/kind b)) (sq/entry-vec b) b)
663+ ka (sq/kind a) kb (sq/kind b)]
664+ (cond (if (= ka 0) (= kb 0) false) 0
665+ (= ka 0) -1
666+ (= kb 0) 1
667+ (if (num-kind? ka) (num-kind? kb) false) (num-cmp a ka b kb)
668+ (if (= ka 17) (= kb 17) false) (bytes-cmp (str-bytes a) (str-bytes b))
669+ (if (if (= ka 20) (= kb 20) false) true (if (= ka 21) (= kb 21) false))
670+ (let [c (part-cmp (named-ns a) (named-ns b))] (if (= c 0) (part-cmp (named-name a) (named-name b)) c))
671+ (if (= ka 15) (= kb 15) false) (- (wasm/get sq/Bool 0 a) (wasm/get sq/Bool 0 b))
672+ (if (= ka 19) (= kb 19) false) (let [x (char-val a) y (char-val b)] (cond (< x y) -1 (> x y) 1 :else 0))
673+ (if (= ka 11) (= kb 11) false) (pvec-cmp a b)
674+ :else (raise-lit (sq/bytes-cat (sq/bytes-cat (sq/bytes-cat (wasm/bytes-of-string "cannot compare ") (sq/type-name-bytes a))
675+ (wasm/bytes-of-string " and "))
676+ (sq/type-name-bytes b))))))
677+
678+(defn compare [a b] (sq/box-int (compare* a b))) ; the core/compare twin is wasm.core/compare (let-go's error text)

680+;; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

186+ n (wasm/alen b)

12+;; XXH3-64 (xsofy's own tests pin it against xxh3sum).

15+;; an lg Int converted to uint64 by two's complement, so -1 is 2^64-1 and
16+;; MinInt64 is 2^63; nil converts to 0. The result is a uint64 boxed as an

18+;; negative number). Input: a byte-array's bytes; a String as the boundary
19+;; converts it, a seq of Chars each truncated to its low byte (so "hello" is
20+;; its bytes but "é" hashes as the one byte 0xE9, not its UTF-8); nil as
21+;; empty. Other reflection coercions (a vector or int-array

220+(defn- rune-bytes [bs] ; each rune's low 8 bits (uint8(rune))
